decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker (entry ~line 11) presented saving that required manual title entry (client paraphrase r1: 'the spec says I'd have to type in the title myself every time'). Round 1 client (line 82): 'When I paste in a web address, I expect the app to go grab the page's title (and ideally a short description) on its own... I still want to be able to correct that title afterward... Please adjust the spec so that saving a link pulls in the page's title automatically (editable by me), rather than requiring me to enter it by hand.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Reference requires auto-collection of metadata (REF-BM-02) and post-hoc editing of the auto-collected title/description (REF-BM-03); the presented spec required manual title entry, a divergence established independently. Client rejects the mismatch and supplies the reference-conforming behavior (auto-fetch, editable) — corrective/correct. Resolved in round 2 revision (line 147) which is the disposition, not a separate opportunity.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker (line 11): 'imports... are excluded for now.' Round 1 client (line 82): 'Leaving out sharing, imports, browser extensions, and folders is okay for a first version.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Reference includes import of Netscape HTML bookmarks (REF-BM-30, extended scope), so excluding imports is a divergence established independently of the response. Client explicitly names the item ('imports') and its absence and accepts the departure without requesting alignment — accepted_divergence with catch_type=none (observable requirement expression, not correction). Sharing/folders/offline/accounts are orthogonal or infra (REF-BM-I01..I05) and excluded from analysis.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker (line 147): 'Rich previews and images remain outside the first release.' Round 2 client (line 226): 'I just paste an address and the title and description come in on their own, I can fix them if needed, and if the lookup fails I still get a sensible title... Approve the spec.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. REF-BM-02 requires auto-collection of title, description, favicon, AND preview image; the round-2 revision covers title/description but explicitly excludes preview images/favicon, a residual divergence on REF-BM-02 established independently. Client's approval addresses only the title/description resolution and never expresses the image/favicon difference — passes without corrective or explicit expression, so unexpressed. Approval alone does not establish whether the difference was noticed.

decisions.evidence: Round 5 maker (line 577): '...duplicate warnings...'. Round 5 client (line 669): 'Saving the same address again warned me it was already there instead of making a duplicate.'
decisions.note: Implementation review. Reference REF-BM-06 requires guiding the user to edit the existing bookmark on a duplicate url rather than creating a new one; the presented and tested duplicate-warning behavior conforms. Recorded conforming decision.
